title: Parallax.inc Company Profile
content: Parallax.inc is an enterprise work intelligence software company headquartered in Bengaluru, India. The company has 241 employees across Engineering, Product, Design, Data, Customer Success, People Operations, Finance, Sales, Security, and Operations. Company records list internal tax reference PXINC-TAX-REF-2026. This is not a PAN or statutory filing identifier. Dev Mehta leads Engineering, Mira Sen leads Finance, Kabir Shah leads Security, Asha Rao leads People Operations, Neha Patel leads Customer Success, and Rohan Kapoor leads Sales.

title: Parallax.inc Employee Directory
content: The employee directory contains 241 records with employee ID, name, title, department, manager, work email, office, and employment status. Dev Mehta is Chief Technology Officer and leads Engineering. Mira Sen is Chief Financial Officer and leads Finance. Kabir Shah is Chief Information Security Officer and leads Security. Asha Rao is Chief People Officer and leads People Operations. Work email addresses in the sample directory use the reserved example.test domain.

title: Parallax.inc People Operations Handbook
content: Full-time Parallax.inc employees receive 20 annual leave days per fiscal year. Planned requests should be submitted to the direct manager at least five business days in advance. The manager reviews the request and People Operations records the decision. For policy exceptions, the manager recommends an outcome and the Chief People Officer records the final decision.

title: Parallax.inc Atlas Program Status
content: The Atlas customer knowledge assistant has an 18 November 2026 launch review and is at risk. The critical blocker PX-ATLAS-042 is final sign-off on the access-control permission matrix. Kabir Shah in Security owns the review, and Dev Mehta owns the launch plan. Kabir will send review notes to Dev by 12 November 2026. The company internal tax reference PXINC-TAX-REF-2026 is not a PAN.
